cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm standing up here beside you. A fair starting position for the race.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the starter. I stand ahead so the runners can see my flag.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. I should see it just as clearly as everyone else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can stand at either end of the starting line, but not ahead of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make the end nearest the finish mine. Same line, better angle.

reason: Replace the unsupported Stance overlay with a concrete mistaken imitation whose correction redirects A's exact Drive pursuit; distinguish the alternative's relationship and immediate pressure.
